name: Fore Deck of the Second Chance
hours: Only during crossings: the ferry runs Wednesdays and Saturdays plus special runs on arrival and departure days. ARRIVAL DAY (Day 1, 08:00–10:40) on the fore deck: nathan — has been over the whole ship since the harbour and reports all of it at full volume; attaches himself to Rowan and comes along anywhere; plays anyone, at once, on a bench with the cards sliding. baylee — standing where he blocks least, one hand on the rail; follows Nathan and Rowan if asked, says little; plays if asked kindly, says first that he is not good. ed — hanging off the bow rail by one hand to see the island sooner; plays anywhere, preferably somewhere he could fall from. georgie — sitting on a coiled rope with her deck box in both hands, being photographed; says yes very quietly to a polite request for a game, never for a stake, and is the strongest player aboard. pippa — photographing Georgie against the volcano (they met ten minutes ago), then anyone who holds still; would sooner take pictures than play, can be coaxed. mikoto — apologising to a gull that has his sandwich; plays gladly and apologises throughout. The first-years not named on any part of the ship are below with the luggage or asleep on their bags and stay there.
sight: A blunt white-and-rust ferry shoulders through green swell, her fore deck slick with spray and crowded with duffel bags, deck boxes and first-years in new jackets. Ahead, Caldera Key climbs out of the haze: a dark cone with a scarf of cloud, jungle running down its flanks to pale sand. An iron stair goes up to the wheelhouse door; under it a doorway leads down into the passenger lounge, and a side deck runs aft past the funnel to the stern. The engine thrums up through the soles of your shoes and the air tastes of salt and diesel.
things: Lean on the bow rail and watch the island grow from a smudge into a mountain
Go down into the passenger lounge, where people are playing
Walk aft along the side deck to the stern
Climb the iron stair to the wheelhouse door
Play a wobbly first table game on a bolted-down bench while the cards try to slide away
Count the collars: white with a gold edge, blue, plain grey
Spot the lighthouse, the cliff tower and the thin white line of the Commons beach as the ferry rounds the south point
Be seasick with dignity, or without
secret: ARRIVAL DAY ABOARD (Day 1, Morning only). The ship is four places with no travel time between them: ferry_deck (fore deck), ferry_lounge, ferry_stern, ferry_bridge; who is where, and whether they will play, stands under Hours of each. Everyone is a stranger to Rowan and to everyone else. CLOCK: she docks at 10:40. Never use @time aboard, only @clock. From about 10:25 the horn sounds and people crowd the rail; at 10:40, or as soon as the player waits or skips ahead (@clock up to that minute), write @place ferry_dock. Nobody is still aboard at 11:00. Duels aboard are casual only, about 25 minutes each. On the fore deck: Rowan is the only first-year without a jacket (late admission; his is issued on the Quad), so nobody can read his dorm from a collar. Nathan repeats to everybody whatever Rowan tells him. A challenge to Rowan can come from two people, each once: Inya in the lounge (see there) and Magnus, if Rowan says his online handle within his hearing or speaks to him. Later crossings: see ferry_bridge for the captain. Day 105 and Day 210 are the last ferries: who stands at the rail with Rowan is decided by the routes.
access: Not a place to visit freely; only as part of a crossing. Leaving the island mid-term without leave counts as absence in every course.
